s2.ptxt: Using SST, install the oxygen sensor to the front exhaust pipe assembly.

s3.ptxt: Using a vernier caliper, measure the free length of the compression spring.

atten4.ptxt: If it is less than the minimum, replace the spring with a new one.

s3.ptxt: Insert a new gasket into the exhaust manifold by hand as far as it will go.
Using a wooden block and hammer, gradually tap in the gasket until it is flush with the exhaust manifold.

item.ptxt: Do not install the gasket in the wrong direction.
Do not reuse a gasket once it has been removed.
Do not damage the gasket by dropping it, etc.
Do not damage the gasket sliding surface.
Never push the gasket in by installing the exhaust pipe without first pressing it in sufficiently by hand.

s2.ptxt: Install the exhaust pipe assembly front with the 2 bolts and 2 compression springs.

atten3.ptxt: After installation, check that there is no significant difference in the clearance between the flanges of the exhaust manifold and exhaust pipe assembly front at the front, rear, left and right.

s2.ptxt: Install a new gasket to the exhaust pipe assembly front.
Install the exhaust center pipe assembly with the 3 exhaust pipe supports.
Install the exhaust center pipe assembly to the exhaust pipe assembly front with the 2 bolts.

s3.ptxt: Using a vernier caliper, measure the free length of the compression spring.
